notes.title: Shit Storm 2?!
notes.notes:
10 years ago, Shit Storm started out as just a joke game for some friends to play and have a laugh.

In 2017 I released it into the wild on Steam for everyone to play. From the bottom of my heart, thank you to everyone who has played Shit Storm, but for years people have been left wanting more.

Introducing: [u][b]Burger Butt![/b][/u]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097810/Burger_Butt/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097810/Burger_Butt/[/url]

[b]What can you expect from Burger Butt?[/b]
More or less the same dumb game but with features that people have actually requested.
These include leaderboards so you can see how you compare to your friends AND other players around the world AND even the ability to play ONLINE with other players in a head to head battle.

[b]When can you expect Burger Butt?[/b]
This one is a little more tricky to answer, but my best guess is sooner rather than later. The game is more or less in a fully functioning state and just needs a good sprinkle of polish and certain features to be fleshed out a little better. Also more hats/skins.

[b]Will you have *insert idea here* hat/skin in the game?[/b]
I will endeavour to have as many cool ideas in the game at launch but if you have an idea that isn't in the game, let me know and I'll be happy to come up with a way to include it into the game.

notes.title: Update 12/07/2018
notes.notes:
Small update for 12/07/18

- Fixed songs not looping when they were supposed to during levels.
- Fixed updated flame sometimes being 90 degrees the wrong way.

- Cleaned up poop that fell all the way down to Earth and landed in my yard.
